AccountMismatch.description: An account whose balance moved by another sum than its journal entries of the period.

alreadyAsked.description: Whether an earlier request had already set the deletion.

deleteAt.description: From when the address is deleted; asking again keeps the first time.

AddressDeletionRequest.description: A mailed link whose address is to be deleted.

token.description: The link's ref, from any mail sent to the address.

error.description: Names the case; a kebab-case code tells it apart, a phrase together with the status code.

BankView.description: The bank as control sees it now.

books.description: null until the ledger answered once.

clients.description: null until the generator answered once.

maintenance.description: The maintenance window that is on, else the next one; null if none is declared.

readAt.description: When control last read the live parts; null before the first read.

startedAt.description: Start of the bank's first period; null before control's first tick.

totals.description: Transfers since the bank started: the reconciled periods and the live numbers of those still open.

Books.description: All balances of the bank against the sum its accounts were opened with.

BooksNow.description: All balances of the bank against the sum its accounts were opened with, read now and then.

available.description: Whether the chaos button works in this deployment.

readyInSeconds.description: Seconds until chaos may be used again; 0 when it may be used now.

ChaosEvent.description: A crash of the ledger's instances, set off from the page.

ClientReconciliationReport.description: The clients' journal against the period's statement, as the generator reported it.

statementFinal.description: No statement line was still in flight.

Clients.description: What the clients count, since the generator started.

gaveUp.description: Transfers whose client stopped trying: refused for good, or without an answer it could use.

refused.description: Transfers the gateway refused as busy (503) at least once, retried or not.

since.description: When the generator started sending; null before.

closesAt.description: When control asks the gateway to close it.

GatewayCounts.description: The period's transfers as the gateway counts them.

entryCount.description: Transfers in the period when the gateway closed it.

InviteRequest.description: An address to mail an invite link to.

email.description: Where the link goes; trimmed and lowercased.

turnstileToken.description: The Turnstile widget's answer; null where the check is off.

InviteRequestAccepted.description: Taken; the same for any address, whether a mail goes out or not.

LedgerCounts.description: The period's transfers as the ledger counts them.

poolPostings.description: Postings between the pool and the accounts; no client sees them.

LoadRequest.description: A load pulse: one of the session's speed and length options.

seconds.description: How long the pulse lasts, in seconds.

tps.description: The bank's speed while the pulse lasts, in transfers a second.

PeriodCheck.description: The ledger's check of a period's books, as the ledger reported it.

accountsCompared.description: False where the ledger holds no balances of the period before to compare with: the bank's first period, and one after a period that failed.

invalidJournalExamples.description: Ids of the first such transfers.

periods.description: The periods that are over, newest first.

postedAmountCents.description: Sum of the posted transfers; 0 if the reporting service could not be read.

PeriodReport.description: The verdict of a period and what it rests on; the bank deletes the transfers themselves after its retention.

books.description: All balances of the bank when the period was reconciled.

chaos.description: Ledger crashes within the period, in order; empty if none.

notes.description: What the report could not show; does not decide the verdict.

rejectionsByReason.description: Rejections by reason, as the ledger decided them.

stats.description: null if the reporting service could not be read.

PeriodStats.description: A period's numbers from the bank's events, as the reporting service counted them.

at.description: When the reporting service read them.

PeriodView.description: A period of the bank as control sees it now.

booksFinalAt.description: When control first saw every accepted transfer applied; null before.

closedAt.description: When the gateway closed the period, by the bank's clock; null before.

failure.description: Why the period ended without a verdict; only when failed.

finishedAt.description: When the period reached a final state; null before.

numbers.description: null before the period is final, and for a failed one whose numbers could not be read.

verdict.description: Only once reconciled. Only BALANCED is green.

PodView.description: One instance of a service, from Prometheus; approximate, a scrape or two behind.

partitions.description: Partitions the ledger instance consumes; null for other services.

up.description: The last scrape got an answer.

Pulse.description: A rise of the load above its base for a while.

ReconciliationBreaks.description: Discrepancies between the clients' journal and the statement, by kind, each with its first examples.

values.description: One value per instant of the grid; null where monitoring has none.

SeriesView.description: The bank's charts from monitoring, on one grid of instants.

from.description: The first instant of the grid.

series.description: Empty if monitoring could not be read.

SessionCreated.description: A new session; its id is the key to it.

SessionView.description: What a session may do now.

chaosAvailable.description: Whether the chaos button works in this deployment.

chaosReadyInSeconds.description: Seconds until chaos may be used again, on the whole cluster; 0 when it may be used now.

defaultLoadSeconds.description: The length offered first, in seconds.

inviteValid.description: False once the invite expired or was switched off; the session can then only look.

loadDurationOptions.description: Lengths a load pulse may last, in seconds, shortest first.

loadReadyInSeconds.description: Seconds until a load pulse may be started again, on the whole bank; 0 when it may be started now.

loadTpsOptions.description: Speeds a load pulse may set, in transfers a second, lowest first.

SiteView.description: What the start, privacy and imprint pages show.

linksPerDay.description: Links an address may get in 24 hours.

operator.description: null where the deployment has not set them.

retentionDays.description: Days without use after which an address is deleted.

turnstileSiteKey.description: The Turnstile widget's site key; null where the check is off.

version.description: The version the site was deployed with.

Slo.description: The bank's availability to its clients over the last days, by minute: a minute is good if nearly every request got an answer; busy (503) is an answer.

availability.description: Share of good minutes among the measured ones, the planned left out; null before the first measured minute.

badMinutes.description: Bad minutes that use up the budget.

budgetMinutes.description: Bad minutes the target allows in a full window.

busyShare.description: Share of requests refused as busy; null before the first request.

measuredMinutes.description: Minutes with requests in the window; a minute without any is not measured.

plannedMinutes.description: Bad minutes within a maintenance window declared in time; they do not use up the budget.

target.description: Share of good minutes the bank aims for.

TransferSide.description: A transfer as one side holds it.

UnknownResolved.description: Transfers the clients did not know the outcome of, settled by asking the bank.

info.description: The bank's state, periods and charts, and invite sessions, for the control page.
